qa.question: What is the minimum password length?

evidence.anchor: Passwords must contain at least 14 characters

qa.question: Is SMS an approved MFA method?

evidence.anchor: SMS is not an approved MFA method

qa.question: How long is an account locked after five failed password attempts?

evidence.anchor: the account is locked for 15 minutes

qa.question: How often must owners rotate service account secrets?

evidence.anchor: rotates secrets at least every 90 days

qa.question: Under the Password & MFA Policy, what is the maximum duration of a Security-approved exception?

evidence.anchor: an expiry of no more than 30 days

qa.question: Who must approve an access request before IT provisions access?

evidence.anchor: The line manager and system owner must approve before IT

qa.question: How soon after discovery must a suspected security incident be reported?

evidence.anchor: no later than 1 hour after discovery

qa.question: How quickly must critical security updates be installed on company devices?

evidence.anchor: within 48 hours of the company deployment notice

qa.question: After how much inactivity does a VPN session disconnect?
Can I connect to the company VPN using a personal laptop, and which device is required?

evidence.anchor: Only company-issued, managed laptops may connect to the VPN
VPN use requires a company-issued, managed laptop

qa.question: If my company laptop is stolen and company sign-in is unavailable, how soon must I report it and which alternate reporting channel can I use?

evidence.anchor: Report loss or theft immediately to Security
